title: 编译与捕获
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。本章把 L0 的 GPU 执行臂中层（与 ch18 同一 zoom）再往『执行形态』维度打开：ch18 讲同一块 GPU 每拍被怎么喂（持久批次+固定地址），本章讲喂进去之后前向到底以什么形态执行——被 Inductor 逐片编译、再被 CUDA graph 整段捕获回放。Part V hook『Python 写的 attention 变成 CUDA graph 重播的 kernel』在本章完成兑现。
hook_suggestion: 「模型的 forward 是 Python 写的，GPU 却不等 Python：vLLM 把模型编译成图、再把图捕成 CUDA graph 一次回放整层 kernel——可 attention 会写 KV cache（副作用）、batch 每拍都在变形，凭什么一张捕好的图能反复命中？形状全等才能回放，这八个字背后是整条设计链。」（从 Part V hook『Python 写的 attention 变成 CUDA graph 重播的 kernel』+ 本章 notes『形状全等才能回放的本质』+ deepread/gpu-exec why_chains[10] 的 pain 段『CUDA graph 录的是对固定地址显存执行这串 kernel launch』提炼为真问题）
scope_note: 本章解读执行臂中层的『执行形态』：前向以 piecewise 编译图 + CUDA graph 回放的形态运行。主线一（启动期·把 Python 变成图，站 1-9，无请求在场）= -O0..-O3 档位解析（一个参数展开为 mode+cudagraph_mode+融合 pass）→ 切图点清单 set_splitting_ops_for_v1（splitting_ops = _attention_ops + kv update 算子）→ 模型构造期两层注册（CustomOp 每算子构造期一次性 dispatch；Attention 层自注册 static_forward_context）→ KV 初始化期（后端最弱链降级 → initialize_cudagraph_keys 预生成全部 BatchDescriptor key）→ compile_or_warm_up_model 编排（warmup dummy 前向触发 Dynamo trace → VllmBackend.split_graph 切图 → PiecewiseCompileInterpreter 逐片 Inductor 编译 + PIECEWISE wrapper + 丢 guard → capture_model 从大到小逐形状捕获）→ 运行期纠察三件套（JIT monitor / freeze GC / sync check）。主线二（运行期·一拍查表回放，站 10-15，每拍心跳）= _determine_batch_execution_and_padding 裁决（cascade attn/encoder 输入禁 FULL、DP 对齐）→ CudagraphDispatcher.dispatch 查表（FULL 精确 key → PIECEWISE relaxed key → NONE）→ padding 四件套把可变 batch 塞进固定形状 → set_forward_context 注入 mode+descriptor（判责在 dispatcher、wrapper 盲信）→ Attention.forward 调统一算子（op 内 get_attention_context 按 layer_name 取执行环境；KV 写拆独立算子 dummy 依赖保序）→ CUDAGraphWrapper 命中即 replay（DEBUG data_ptr 断言）。边界：FlashAttention 数学归 ch20（primer）；注意力后端选择/优先级表/逐 KV 组混布归 ch21（本章只消费 min_cg_support 最弱链这个接口）；slot_mapping 的 Triton 数学归 ch22（本章只讲尾部 -1 pad 的图捕获语义）；CpuGpuBuffer/持久批次细节归 ch18（本章消费其固定地址——回放命中的后半条件）；异步调度归 ch12；模型 V2 runner（vllm/v1/worker/gpu/）实验性，全书锚定 V1，只作展望脚注；DBO/ubatching、EPLB、encoder cudagraph 属扩展态不进首读。
one_line: vLLM 把模型前向变成两种『预制形态』：torch.compile 在 splitting_ops（注意力等不可融合算子）处切图、片内 Inductor 编译、片间接缝 eager（piecewise）；CUDA graph 再按 BatchDescriptor（num_tokens/num_reqs/uniform/lora 计数）为 key 逐形状捕获整段 kernel launch——运行期每拍查表命中即回放，而『形状全等 AND 地址不变』两个命中条件分别由 dispatcher 的 padding 尺寸表与 ch18 的固定地址缓冲供给，编译/捕获/warmup/防退化全部前移启动期，运行期零惊喜。

stations.what: 档位表：-O0..-O3 预设（OptimizationLevel L104-L116）——O0 无编译无图、O1 Dynamo+Inductor+PIECEWISE、O2（默认，L409）= FULL_AND_PIECEWISE + 按硬件谓词的融合 pass。落账在 VllmConfig post_init（L1272-L1300：optimization_level>O0 → mode=VLLM_COMPILE；custom_ops 基础档 Inductor→'none' 否则 'all'，L1285-L1292）。量化侧伏笔：blocked weights → 强制 '+quant_fp8'（L1261-L1268 注释自述 On H100 the CUDA kernel is faster than native）【F10 苗】

切图点清单 set_splitting_ops_for_v1：splitting_ops = _attention_ops 13 个算子（L764-L778）+ unified_kv_cache_update/unified_mla_kv_cache_update（L1183-L1184——其字符串参数阻止 Inductor 复用 piecewise 图，issue #33267 注释原话，故移出编译图）；注释：full cudagraph 也保留 piecewise fx 图结构、在全图外捕（PR #20059）

CustomOp 构造期 dispatch：每个算子（如 RMSNorm，layernorm.py:L36-L122 的 register("rms_norm")+forward_native/forward_cuda/forward_xpu）在 __init__ 一次性把 _forward_method 绑定为当前平台/开关的具名方法（L130-L133）；enabled()（±name 开关，L271-L293）→ disabled 走 maybe_compile(forward_native)（L209-L269：op 内调用的算子对模型级 torch.compile 不可见，故单独编译）；default_on()：Inductor 时 'none'（让编译器融合）否则 'all'（L295-L311）。运行期 forward 只一次属性转发零分支（L135-L136）——『kernel 融合』与『手工 fused kernel』二选一的解法

Attention 构造自注册：prefix 重名即 raise（L444-L445）、注册进 compilation_config.static_forward_context[prefix]（L446）——『模型定义域在构造期产出层注册表，本域在运行期消费』；use_direct_call = not current_platform.opaque_attention_op()（L437-L441）平台决定走 torch op 还是直调。forward 签名从此不见 attn_metadata（metadata 透传旧设计的终结）

keys 预生成：initialize_cudagraph_keys 按 cudagraph_capture_sizes × lora_cases 笛卡尔积生成全部合法 BatchDescriptor key（cudagraph_keys 是『运行期合法图的唯一真相源』docstring L20-L24）；FULL 档要求 num_reqs 精确——注释原话 FULL mode needs exact num_reqs because FA3's scheduler_metadata computation depends on it（L199-L202），PIECEWISE 放宽 num_reqs=None（L201-L203）；bs→padded 尺寸表 L72-L109（段内上取整、compile_sizes 不得被 padding 改写）。上游：_check_and_update_cudagraph_mode 最弱链降级（gpu_model_runner.py:L7161-L7202 → resolve_cudagraph_mode_and_sizes，config/compilation.py:L1368-L1472）

启动编排 compile_or_warm_up_model：warmup_sizes 逐个 _dummy_run（L706-L708，首个 dummy 前向触发站 7-8 的编译）→ kernel_warmup 调优（L713）→ capture_model（L715-L717，站 9）→ 末 PP 段 sampler 预热（L796-L816，NOTE 刻意在 capture 后防 empty_cache 清缓冲）→ trigger_inductor_lazy_init（L822-L830，注释 rather than on a later compile cache-miss at runtime）→ activate_jit_monitor（L832-L839）→ freeze_gc_heap（L841-L844）→ enable_gpu_sync_check（L846-L848）——编译/捕获/warmup/防退化全部前移，运行期零惊喜

首次前向切图：warmup 的 dummy run 触发 Dynamo trace → VllmBackend.__call__（L1020；can only be called once，L1168）→ split_graph(graph, fx_split_ops)（L1179 调用 → L553-L627 算法：遍历 FX 节点按 should_split（partition_rules.py:L14-L38）编 subgraph_id，连续切点合并 L583-L589、空子图回并 L593、keep_original_order=True 保突变语义 L595-L608——注释原话 otherwise pytorch might reorder the nodes and the semantics of the graph will change when we have mutations）

逐片编译：PiecewiseCompileInterpreter.call_module 把非切分子图建 PiecewiseBackend（Inductor 编译，L755-L764）→ wrap_with_cudagraph_if_needed 挂回（L766-L772 ← L633-L684：每片包 CUDAGraphWrapper(PIECEWISE)，首片 debug 日志/非首片 gc_disable/末片 weak_ref_output）。防重编译由 TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper 丢全部 guard + fullgraph=True + dynamic=False 一次编译永不回看（wrapper.py:L47-L154）。接缝（每层 attention+KV update）仍 eager——flash_attn.py:L880-L888 NOTE 原话：view/slice surprisingly slow even when they do not invoke any GPU ops

捕获：capture_model 先 set_cudagraph_capturing_enabled(True)（L6832）；从大到小（L6829-L6831 注释原话 Capture the large shapes first so that the smaller shapes can reuse the memory pool；get_capture_descs 降序 cudagraph_dispatcher.py:L326-L350）；逐形状 _warmup_and_capture（L6920-L6966：先 num_warmups 次 eager dummy（mode=NONE）→ is_graph_capturing=True 捕一次）；捕完 set_cudagraph_capturing_enabled(False)（L6900）——意外捕获直接 RuntimeError（monitor.py:L90-L99）；This usually takes 5~20 seconds（L6912）

一拍①裁决：execute_model 内 _determine_batch_execution_and_padding（L3932-L4044：dispatch_cudagraph 闭包 L3977-L3985；cascade attention / encoder 输入禁 FULL（L3987-L3989）；DP 各 rank coordinate_batch_across_dp 对齐后 re-dispatch（L4004-L4027——cudagraph key 不一致会让集合通信挂死）；CUDAGraphStat num_paddings 观测 L4029-L4036）

一拍②查表 dispatch：越界/未初始化/超 max_size 落 NONE（L274-L281）→ 构造 padded batch_desc（_create_padded_batch_descriptor L132-L156）→ 先查 FULL 精确 key（L307-L311）→ 再查 PIECEWISE relaxed key（num_reqs=None，L313-L318）→ 都 miss 落 NONE eager（L320-L324）。invalid_modes 供 cascade 等场景禁 FULL

一拍③padding 四件套（主锚 query_start_loc 尾部填非递减——注释原话 kernels like FlashAttention requires that）：block_table 尾行填 NULL_BLOCK_ID（L2338-L2341，Block 0 is reserved for padding）、slot_mapping 尾部填 -1（L4128-L4130，KV 写 kernel 跳过 pad 槽）、positions 尾部清零（L3663-L3664）——把每拍变形的 batch 塞进捕获时的固定形状

一拍④注入：set_forward_context(attn_metadata, num_tokens_padded, cudagraph_runtime_mode=cudagraph_mode, batch_descriptor=batch_desc, slot_mapping) 内 _model_forward（L3879-L3909）——mode+descriptor 经 thread-local（vllm/forward_context.py:L259-L344）传给图内的 wrapper；判责在 dispatcher、wrapper 盲信（cuda_graph.py:L240-L254）。上方注释 Run the model. Use persistent buffers for CUDA graphs.——ch18 固定地址的接口

一拍⑤算子化前向：每个 Attention 层 forward 预分配 output（L531）、QKV reshape 刻意在 op 外（NOTE L534-L535 minimize the CPU overheads）→ torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output（L574-L581）；KV 写拆成独立算子 unified_kv_cache_update（L775-L798，返回 key.new_empty(0) 作 dummy 数据依赖传入保序——L829-L832 注释原话 accepting it creates a data dependency that ensures torch.compile preserves ordering）；op 内 get_attention_context（L732-L772）按 layer_name 从 ForwardContext 取 metadata/kv_cache/slot_mapping——不设 context 直接 assert 崩（forward_context.py:L199-L205）

一拍⑥回放：CUDAGraphWrapper.__call__ 从 forward_context 取 mode+descriptor（盲信，L240-L254）→ key 命中：DEBUG 模式逐 data_ptr 断言与捕获时一致（L346-L355 错误信息原话 Input addresses for cudagraphs are different during replay）→ cudagraph.replay()（L360）；未命中即捕（L265-L337：validate_cudagraph_capturing_enabled 先验、共享图池、输出弱引用）。全图 wrapper 挂载点：load_model 尾部 CUDAGraphWrapper(FULL)（gpu_model_runner.py:L5467-L5469）——FULL 在模型外、PIECEWISE 在编译器内的每片上，各认领自己的 mode

stations_note: 站号 = 编译与捕获生命周期：配置与构造期（1-4，无请求在场）→ keys 与启动编排（5-6）→ 编译与捕获（7-9，站 6 编排的内部展开，仍无请求）→ 运行期一拍（10-15，每拍心跳）。与 ch17/18 衔接：ch17 站 10 的『execute_model 前向黑盒』与 ch18 站 9 的『固定地址喂图（编译与捕获全章 → ch19）』在本章打开——站 13 的调用点即 ch18 站 9 同一处。与 ch20/21 衔接：op 内转调的 backend.impl.forward（flash_attn.py:L880 起）的数学归 ch20、后端选择归 ch21（本章只消费 min_cg_support 接口，站 5）。与 ch22 衔接：slot_mapping 尾部 -1 只讲图捕获语义，position→物理 slot 的 Triton 数学归 ch22。与 ch12 衔接：异步调度下本拍 dispatch 用乐观 seq_lens、纠偏在 GPU 端（深讲已立）。与 ch27 衔接：站 1 的 '+quant_fp8' 强制与站 14 的 query_quant 融合注释是 F10『量化与 kernel 的耦合』的苗。与 ch34 衔接：DP 对齐 coordinate_batch_across_dp 只讲到『key 不一致通信挂死』一层，分布式全貌归 ch34。

key_classes.name: CustomOp
key_classes.responsibility: 多平台算子基类：forward_native/cuda/hip/cpu/xpu/tpu 多实现 + op_registry 全局注册 + 构造期 dispatch_forward 一次性绑定 _forward_method（L103-L207）；enabled/default_on 开关协议（L271-L311）；maybe_compile 给被不透明算子包住的调用单独编译 forward_native（L209-L269）。姊妹机制 PluggableLayer（L32-L100）：模块级组装抽象、不做 per-platform dispatch，供 OOT 整层替换。

key_classes.name: CudagraphDispatcher
key_classes.responsibility: 运行期查表器：预计算 bs→padded 尺寸表（L72-L109）、initialize_cudagraph_keys 生成全部合法 BatchDescriptor key（L166-L233，cudagraph_keys 是唯一真相源）、dispatch 每拍返回 (mode, batch_desc)（L235-L324）、get_capture_descs 给捕获器降序形状（L326-L350）。判责在上游、wrapper 盲信下游。

key_classes.name: CUDAGraphWrapper
key_classes.responsibility: 捕获/回放包装（L145）：按 BatchDescriptor 建 concrete_cudagraph_entries 表项；捕获走共享图池 + 输出弱引用（L265-L337）；回放前 DEBUG 逐 data_ptr 断言（L346-L355）；不存持久缓冲、不拷输入——固定地址是 runner 的职责（docstring L161-L167）。

key_classes.name: BatchDescriptor
key_classes.responsibility: frozen dataclass（L29-L58）：num_tokens/num_reqs/uniform/has_lora/num_active_loras——CUDA graph 查表的 key，『形状全等』的形式化。

key_classes.name: ForwardContext
key_classes.responsibility: 每拍执行环境的 thread-local 载体（L131-L194）：no_compile_layers（static_forward_context 拷贝）/attn_metadata/slot_mapping/cudagraph_runtime_mode/batch_descriptor；set_forward_context（L259-L344）由 runner 每拍注入。

key_classes.name: Attention
key_classes.responsibility: 算子化的注意力层：构造期自注册 static_forward_context（L443-L446）；forward 只做 reshape + 调统一算子（L488-L582）；KV 写拆 unified_kv_cache_update 用 dummy 依赖保序（L775-L814）；unified_attention_with_output 经 get_attention_context 取执行环境转调 backend impl（L817-L846）。本章只讲其算子化与注册面，后端选择归 ch21。

key_classes.name: VllmBackend
key_classes.responsibility: torch.compile 的 vLLM 定制后端（L805）：__call__ 在 Dynamo trace 完成后 split_graph 切图（L1020-L1179）+ 缓存目录管理；『The major work of this backend is to split the graph into piecewise graphs, and pass them to the piecewise backend.』（docstring L810-L811）。

key_classes.name: PiecewiseCompileInterpreter
key_classes.responsibility: 片间拼跑（L687 起）：fx.Interpreter 按序执行 split_gm，命中编译名单的子图建 PiecewiseBackend（Inductor）并包 cudagraph wrapper，其余（切点算子）eager 直调——piecewise 的运行形态。

key_classes.name: TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper
key_classes.responsibility: 防重编译包装（L47）：丢全部 guard（guard_filter_fn L105-L125）+ torch.compile(fullgraph=True, dynamic=False)（L147-L154）——一次编译永不回看；@support_torch_compile（decorators.py:L118 起）把它注入模型类基类。

key_classes.name: RMSNorm

why_chains.decision: CustomOp：每个算子多平台实现（forward_cuda/forward_native/...）+ 全局注册表，构造期一次性 dispatch
why_chains.old_design: 算子层直接调 fused CUDA kernel。快，但对 torch.compile 完全不透明——Inductor 无法融合穿过 opaque kernel；每个硬件平台用 if-else 分支；eager 模式下 native 实现又太慢。
why_chains.pain: 『kernel 融合』与『手工 fused kernel』二选一：Inductor 编译模式下手工 fused op 反而挡路（挡住相邻算子融合），eager 模式下没有它又太慢。
why_chains.solution: vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py:L103-L311 CustomOp 基类：forward_cuda/forward_hip/forward_cpu/forward_xpu/forward_tpu/forward_native 多实现（L138-L172）；__init__ 时 dispatch_forward 一次性把 _forward_method 绑定为当前平台/编译模式的具名函数（L174-L207：先查 enabled()，disabled 走 maybe_compile(forward_native)，enabled 按 current_platform 分支返回各平台方法），运行期 forward 只一次属性转发零分支（L135-L136）。开关规则 default_on()：Inductor 后端时 custom_ops 默认 'none'（走 forward_native 让编译器融合），否则 'all'（L295-L311）。op_registry 全局注册（register L313-L327）+ OOT 类替换（__new__ L109-L128、register_oot L338-L360）。disabled 时 forward_native 可被 maybe_compile 单独编译（L209-L269——"Compile forward_native to avoid eager torch ops if inside opaque torch custom op"，dynamic=True 防重编译，_dynamic_arg_dims 显式标动态维 L238-L261）。v0.27 新增姊妹机制 PluggableLayer（L32-L100）：模块级组装抽象，不做 per-platform dispatch，供 OOT 整层替换。
why_chains.cost: 每个 CustomOp 要维护并测试多份实现、保证数值一致；dispatch 在构造时冻结——运行期不可切换；op_registry/op_registry_oot 是全局可变状态（enabled/disabled_custom_ops 计数进 compilation_config L741-L745）。

why_chains.decision: 注意力=不透明自定义算子：layer_name 进图、metadata 走 thread-local forward context
why_chains.old_design: v0/v1 早期：attention 层 forward 直接调 kernel，attn_metadata 作为参数从 model.forward 一路透传（污染所有模型 forward 签名）；torch.compile 遇动态控制流+外部副作用（写 KV cache）无法全图捕获。forward context 机制 2024-10-03 才引入（9aaf14c62 "[misc] add forward context for attention (#9029)"，git diff-filter=A 实证 forward_context.py 生日）。
why_chains.pain: (1) metadata 透传把『执行环境』泄漏进『模型定义』——每个模型文件的 forward 签名都被引擎内部结构绑架；(2) 想用 torch.compile 就必须让 attention 变成图里的一个节点。
why_chains.solution: 0f8cafe2d "[Kernel] unified_attention for Attention.forward (#11967)"（2025-01-13）确立算子化。Attention.__init__ 把自己注册进 compilation_config.static_forward_context[prefix]（vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/attention.py:L443-L446，重名即 raise L444-L445）；forward（L488-L582）只调 out-variant 算子：预分配 output（L531）、QKV reshape 在 op 外做以省 op 内 CPU 开销（L533-L541 NOTE(woosuk) "We do this outside the custom op to minimize the CPU overheads"）；CUDA 系平台走 torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output（L574-L581），非 opaque 平台直调 Python 函数（L543-L561；分叉开关 use_direct_call = not current_platform.opaque_attention_op() L437-L441）。算子实现 unified_attention_with_output（L817-L846）经 get_attention_context（L732-L772）从 ForwardContext 按 layer_name 取 attn_metadata/kv_cache/slot_mapping（ForwardContext 由 execute_model 的 set_forward_context 每拍设置：forward_context.py:L259-L344，执行期锚 gpu_model_runner.py:L4432-L4449；no_compile_layers 字段即 static_forward_context 的拷贝 forward_context.py:L229-L231）。KV 写拆成独立算子 unified_kv_cache_update（L775-L814），其返回的空张量作为 dummy 数据依赖传入 attention 算子保序（L829-L832 "accepting it creates a data dependency that ensures torch.compile preserves ordering"）。fake_impl 让 Dynamo 可 trace（L801-L806、L849-L859）。v0.27 演进：layer_name 字符串用 LayerName opaque 类型包一层（vllm/utils/torch_utils.py:L845-L870——"torch.compile lifts it as a graph input instead of baking it as a constant. This avoids per-layer recompilation for custom ops that accept layer name strings"，_encode/_resolve L881-L888），旧方案 fast_moe_cold_start 的 ForwardContext 列表弹出法仍并存（forward_context.py:L160-L186）。
why_chains.cost: 隐式全局状态：不设 forward context 直接调 attention 即 assert 崩（forward_context.py:L199-L205）；调用栈只见 op 名不见层名，profiler 需专门映射；forward_includes_kv_cache_update 语义分叉（vllm/v1/attention/backend.py:L67 默认 True，FlashAttentionBackend 改 False flash_attn.py:L86）——即 CUDA 上 KV 写与 attention 是两个 op 各多一次 dispatch，且 v0.27 起 execute_model 要按 has_separate_kv_update 决定 slot_mapping 用 padded 维度（gpu_model_runner.py:L4307-L4317）。

why_chains.decision: piecewise 分片编译：在注意力等『不可融合算子』处切图，片内编译、片间接缝 eager（同一问题的三代解法并存）
why_chains.old_design: 全图 torch.compile 或全 eager 二选一。全 eager：每层几十次 kernel launch 走 Python dispatch，decode 小 batch 时 CPU 是瓶颈；全图 compile：attention 的外部副作用/动态分支进不了图，且动态 batch 触发反复重编译（guard 检查+recompile 抖动）。
why_chains.pain: 同异步调度链的 CPU overhead 战线——『编译单元』必须从整模型降到层间连续段，否则要么 CPU 喂不上、要么图捕不进。
why_chains.solution: ff5ed6e1b "[torch.compile] rework compile control with piecewise cudagraph (#9715)"（2024-10-29）确立正典方案：splitting_ops 列表 = _attention_ops（"vllm::unified_attention_with_output"、unified_mla、mamba_mixer2/mixer、short_conv、linear_attention、qwen_gdn、sparse_attn_indexer、deepseek_v4_attention 等 13 个，vllm/config/compilation.py:L764-L778）+ "vllm::unified_kv_cache_update"/"unified_mla_kv_cache_update"（set_splitting_ops_for_v1 L1155-L1184；注释：KV update 算子的字符串参数阻止 Inductor 复用 piecewise 图故移出编译图——LayerName opaque 正是根治此问题的下一代方案）。VllmBackend.split_graph 在命中 splitting_ops 的 FX 节点处切图（vllm/compilation/backends.py:L553-L627；连续切点合并 L583-L589、空子图回并 _merge_empty_only_subgraphs L437-L478、keep_original_order 保语义 L595-L608），每片独立送 Inductor 编译并包 CUDAGraphWrapper(PIECEWISE)（wrap_with_cudagraph_if_needed L633-L684：首片开 debug 日志、非首片禁 GC、末片 weak_ref output），运行期 PiecewiseCompileInterpreter 按序拼跑（L687 起）。防重编译：TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper fullgraph=True + dynamic=False + 丢全部 guard 一次编译永不回看（vllm/compilation/wrapper.py:L47-L54、L105-L125、L147-L154）。v0.27 两条新路线并存（都默认关）：(a) use_inductor_graph_partition=True（config/compilation.py:L669-L687）——不在 Dynamo FX 层切而在 Inductor codegen 完成全部融合 pass 之后按 cudagraph_unsafe tag 分区，RoPE+KV cache 融合等 pass 只在此模式可用（L1162-L1184 的 warning 链证明依赖关系）；(b) BreakableCUDAGraph（8a56da384 "[Experimental] Breakable CUDA graph (#42304)" 2026-05-16、27fa5aa3b "(#44050)" MRV2 支持实验；vllm/compilation/breakable_cudagraph.py:L5-L25）——干脆不预切图：单个 capture context 驱动整个 forward，在 attention/kv-cache 算子 dispatcher 处『结束当前段捕获→eager 执行→恢复捕获』（@eager_break_during_capture 装饰器 L52-L80，要求被装饰算子写调用方预分配的 output，否则地址漂移炸下游图段）；灵感自 sglang#19102；env 门 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH 默认 0（envs.py:L170）。

why_chains.decision: CUDA Graph 捕获回放：按 BatchDescriptor 查表命中，实际 batch padding 到捕获形状
why_chains.old_design: eager 每拍重新 launch 全部 kernel（Python dispatch + cudaLaunchKernel × 每层数十次）。v0 已有按 batch size 捕获的 cudagraph；v1 的重做核心是显式 dispatch 协议（74f441f4b "Allow full cudagraph with separate attention routines (#20059)" 2025-08-15 引入 cudagraph_dispatcher.py，git diff-filter=A 实证），2025-09-23 24fab45d9 "Change default CUDAGraphMode from PIECEWISE to FULL_AND_PIECEWISE (#25444)" 把默认档位升到混合模式。
why_chains.pain: 为什么形状必须精确匹配（本质）：CUDA graph 录的是『对这块固定地址的显存执行这串 kernel launch』——kernel 的 grid/block 配置、指针、乃至宿主端分支（如 FA3 的 scheduler_metadata 计算）都在捕获时烤死在图里；replay 不会重新读取张量的 shape 元数据。形状或地址变了，图执行的就是错误的工作量/错误的数据。所以回放命中条件 = BatchDescriptor 全等 AND 输入张量地址不变。

def maybe_compile(self, fn, *, enable: bool = True):
        """
        Compile fn if compilation enabled.
        Useful for CustomOp instances called from within a torch custom op,
        meaning the forward call is hidden from the model-level torch.compile.

        NOTE: this does not enable fusion across ops, so opaque custom ops
        should still be unwrapped wherever possible.
        """
        from vllm.config.compilation import CompilationMode

        # Do not compile if compilation disabled
        if not enable:
            return fn

        # Do not compile if global compilation disabled
        compilation_config = get_cached_compilation_config()
        if compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.NONE:
            return fn

        # If eager backend is used, do not compile either
        if compilation_config.backend == "eager":
            return fn

@classmethod
    def enabled(cls) -> bool:
        # if no name, then it was not registered
        compilation_config = get_cached_compilation_config()
        custom_ops = compilation_config.custom_ops
        if not hasattr(cls, "name"):
            logger.warning_once(
                "Custom op %s was not registered, which means it won't appear "
                "in the op registry. It will be enabled/disabled based on the "
                "global settings.",
                cls.__name__,
            )
            return CustomOp.default_on()

        enabled = f"+{cls.name}" in custom_ops
        disabled = f"-{cls.name}" in custom_ops
        if enabled and disabled:
            raise ValueError(
                "custom_ops cannot both enable and disable the same operation: "
                f"{cls.name}. Remove either the '+' or '-' directive"
            )

        return (CustomOp.default_on() or enabled) and not disabled

    @staticmethod
    def default_on() -> bool:
        """
        Behavior controlled by `CompilationConfig.custom_ops`: On by default if
        'all', off by default if 'none'.
        When PyTorch Inductor is used, 'none' is the default value,
        otherwise 'all'.
        """
        compilation_config = get_cached_compilation_config()
        count_none = compilation_config.custom_ops.count("none")
        count_all = compilation_config.custom_ops.count("all")
        if count_none + count_all != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "custom_ops must contain exactly one base mode: 'all' or 'none'"
            )

        return not count_none > 0 or count_all > 0

def get_attention_context(
    layer_name: str,
) -> tuple[Any, "Attention | MLAAttention", torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """Extract attention context for a given layer.

    This helper function extracts the attention metadata, attention layer
    instance, KV cache tensor, and slot mapping for a specific layer.

    Args:
        layer_name: The name/identifier of the attention layer.

    Returns:
        A tuple containing:
        - attn_metadata: Attention metadata for this specific layer, or None if
            no metadata available
        - attn_layer: The attention layer instance (Attention or MLAAttention)
        - kv_cache: The KV cache tensor for current forward pass
        - slot_mapping: The slot mapping for this specific layer

        Note: attn_metadata may be None, but attn_layer and kv_cache are always
        extracted from the forward context.
    """
    forward_context: ForwardContext = get_forward_context()
    attn_metadata_raw = forward_context.attn_metadata
    attn_metadata: AttentionMetadata
    if isinstance(attn_metadata_raw, dict):
        attn_metadata = attn_metadata_raw[layer_name]
    elif isinstance(attn_metadata_raw, list):
        # list[dict[str, AttentionMetadata]]: used in speculative decoding
        # where [0] is the base-model (non-speculative) metadata dict.
        attn_metadata = attn_metadata_raw[0][layer_name]
    else:
        attn_metadata = attn_metadata_raw
    attn_layer: Attention | MLAAttention = forward_context.no_compile_layers[layer_name]
    kv_cache = attn_layer.kv_cache
    slot_mapping = forward_context.slot_mapping
    assert isinstance(slot_mapping, dict), (
        f"Expected slot_mapping to be a dict, got {type(slot_mapping)}. "
    )
    layer_slot_mapping = slot_mapping.get(layer_name)
    return attn_metadata, attn_layer, kv_cache, layer_slot_mapping

def unified_kv_cache_update(
    key: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
    layer_name: LayerNameType,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Returns a dummy that is passed to unified_attention to signal a side effect and
    the data dependency between them to ensure torch.compile preserves ordering.
    """
    layer_name = _resolve_layer_name(layer_name)
    _, attn_layer, kv_cache, layer_slot_mapping = get_attention_context(layer_name)
    if layer_slot_mapping is not None:
        assert hasattr(attn_layer.impl, "do_kv_cache_update"), (
            f"{attn_layer.impl.__class__.__name__} does not support kv cache update"
        )
        attn_layer.impl.do_kv_cache_update(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            attn_layer,
            key,
            value,
            kv_cache,
            layer_slot_mapping,
        )

    return key.new_empty(0)


def unified_kv_cache_update_fake(
    key: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
    layer_name: LayerNameType,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    return torch.empty(0, device=key.device, dtype=key.dtype)


direct_register_custom_op(
    op_name="unified_kv_cache_update",
    op_func=unified_kv_cache_update,
    fake_impl=unified_kv_cache_update_fake,
    mutates_args=[],
)

@maybe_transfer_kv_layer
def unified_attention_with_output(
    query: torch.Tensor,
    key: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
    output: torch.Tensor,
    layer_name: LayerNameType,
    output_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    output_block_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> None:

    # that ensures torch.compile preserves ordering between KV cache update and
    # attention forward.

    layer_name = _resolve_layer_name(layer_name)
    attn_metadata, self, kv_cache, _ = get_attention_context(layer_name)

        self,
        query,
        key,
        value,
        kv_cache,
        attn_metadata,
        output=output,
        output_scale=output_scale,
        output_block_scale=output_block_scale,

def should_split(node: torch.fx.Node, splitting_ops: list[str]) -> bool:
    """
    Check if a node should be split for dynamo graph partition.
    It operates on dynamo graph, so the node.target can be anything.
    We need to check and split only on OpOverload and OpOverloadPacket.
    """

    if node.op != "call_function":
        return False

    target = node.target

    if isinstance(target, torch._ops.OpOverloadPacket):
        # Example: "aten::add"
        return target._qualified_op_name in splitting_ops

    if isinstance(target, torch._ops.OpOverload):
        # Example: "aten::add"
        packet_name = target.name()

        # Example: "aten::add.default"
        op_overload_name = f"{packet_name}.{target._overloadname}"
        return op_overload_name in splitting_ops or packet_name in splitting_ops

    return False

def split_graph(
    graph: fx.GraphModule, splitting_ops: list[str]
) -> tuple[fx.GraphModule, list[SplitItem]]:
    _decompose_size_nodes(graph)

    # split graph by ops
    subgraph_id = 0
    node_to_subgraph_id: dict[fx.Node, int] = {}
    split_op_graphs: list[int] = []
    for node in graph.graph.nodes:
        if node.op in ("output", "placeholder"):
            continue

        # Check if this is a getitem operation on a node from an earlier subgraph.
        # If so, assign it to the same subgraph as its input to avoid passing entire
        # tuple as input to submodules, which is against standalone_compile and
        # AoTAutograd input requirement.
        if node.op == "call_function" and node.target == operator.getitem:
            # Assign this getitem to the same subgraph as its input
            input_node = node.args[0]
            if input_node.op != "placeholder":
                assert input_node in node_to_subgraph_id
                node_to_subgraph_id[node] = node_to_subgraph_id[input_node]
                continue

        if should_split(node, splitting_ops):
            subgraph_id += 1
            node_to_subgraph_id[node] = subgraph_id
            split_op_graphs.append(subgraph_id)

            # keep consecutive splitting ops together
            # (we know node.next exists because node isn't the last (output) node)
            if should_split(node.next, splitting_ops):
                # this will get incremented by the next node
                subgraph_id -= 1
            else:
                subgraph_id += 1
        else:
            node_to_subgraph_id[node] = subgraph_id

    _merge_empty_only_subgraphs(node_to_subgraph_id, split_op_graphs)

    # `keep_original_order` is important!
    # otherwise pytorch might reorder the nodes and
    # the semantics of the graph will change when we
    # have mutations in the graph
    with _use_lazy_graph_module(True):
        has_tuple_return = is_torch_equal_or_newer("2.12.0.dev")
        tuple_return_kwarg = {"tuple_return": True} if has_tuple_return else {}
        split_gm = torch.fx.passes.split_module.split_module(
            graph,
            None,
            lambda node: node_to_subgraph_id[node],
            keep_original_order=True,
            **tuple_return_kwarg,
        )

    outputs = []

    names = [name for (name, module) in split_gm.named_modules()]

    for name in names:
        if "." in name or name == "":
            # recursive child module or the root module
            continue

        module = getattr(split_gm, name)

        graph_id = int(name.replace("submod_", ""))
        outputs.append(SplitItem(name, graph_id, (graph_id in split_op_graphs), module))

    # sort by integer graph_id, rather than string name
    outputs.sort(key=lambda x: x.graph_id)

    return split_gm, outputs

def wrap_with_cudagraph_if_needed(
    piecewise_backend: Any,
    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
    compilation_config: CompilationConfig,
    is_first_graph: bool,
    is_last_graph: bool,
) -> Any:
    """
    Wrap a piecewise backend with CUDA graph wrapper if needed.
    This function is shared between VllmBackend and
    construct_serializable_fn_from_inductor_cache.

    Args:
        piecewise_backend: The backend to wrap
        vllm_config: The vLLM configuration
        compilation_config: The compilation configuration
        is_first_graph: Whether this is the first graph in the sequence
        is_last_graph: Whether this is the last graph in the sequence

    Returns:
        The wrapped backend if CUDA graphs are enabled, otherwise the original backend
    """
    if (
        not compilation_config.cudagraph_mode.has_piecewise_cudagraphs()
        or compilation_config.use_inductor_graph_partition
    ):
        return piecewise_backend

    # We're using Dynamo-based piecewise splitting, so we wrap
    # the whole subgraph with a static graph wrapper.
    from .cuda_graph import CUDAGraphOptions

    # resolve the static graph wrapper class (e.g. CUDAGraphWrapper
    # class) as platform dependent.
    static_graph_wrapper_class = resolve_obj_by_qualname(
        current_platform.get_static_graph_wrapper_cls()
    )

    # Always assign PIECEWISE runtime mode to the
    # CUDAGraphWrapper for piecewise_backend, to distinguish
    # it from the FULL cudagraph runtime mode, no matter it
    # is wrapped on a full or piecewise fx graph.
    return static_graph_wrapper_class(
        runnable=piecewise_backend,
        vllm_config=vllm_config,
        runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE,
        cudagraph_options=CUDAGraphOptions(
            debug_log_enable=is_first_graph,
            gc_disable=not is_first_graph,
            weak_ref_output=is_last_graph,
        ),
    )

def call_module(
        self,
        target: torch.fx.node.Target,
        args: tuple[torch.fx.node.Argument, ...],
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Any:
        assert isinstance(target, str)

        gm = getattr(self.module, target)
        outputs = gm.graph.output_node().args[0]
        output = fx.map_arg(outputs, lambda node: node.meta["example_value"])

        if target in self.compile_submod_names:
            index = self.compile_submod_names.index(target)
            submod = self.fetch_attr(target)

            sym_shape_indices = [
                i for i, x in enumerate(args) if isinstance(x, torch.SymInt)
            ]

            # Lazy import here to avoid circular import
            from torch._inductor.compile_fx import graph_returns_tuple

            from .piecewise_backend import PiecewiseBackend

            piecewise_backend = PiecewiseBackend(
                submod,
                self.vllm_config,
                index,
                len(self.compile_submod_names),
                sym_shape_indices,
                self.vllm_backend,
                graph_returns_tuple(submod),
                submod_name=target,
            )

            self.module.__dict__[target] = wrap_with_cudagraph_if_needed(
                piecewise_backend,
                self.vllm_config,
                self.compilation_config,
                piecewise_backend.is_first_graph,
                piecewise_backend.is_last_graph,
            )

            compilation_counter.num_piecewise_capturable_graphs_seen += 1

        return output

    """

        self,
        num_tokens: int,
        uniform_decode: bool,
        has_lora: bool,
        num_active_loras: int = 0,
    ) -> BatchDescriptor:

        uniform_decode_query_len = self.uniform_decode_query_len
        num_tokens_padded = self._bs_to_padded_graph_size[num_tokens]

            num_tokens=num_tokens_padded,

            uniform=uniform_decode,
            has_lora=has_lora,
            num_active_loras=num_active_loras,

def dispatch(
        self,
        num_tokens: int,
        uniform_decode: bool = False,
        has_lora: bool = False,
        num_active_loras: int = 0,
        valid_modes: AbstractSet[CUDAGraphMode] | None = None,
        invalid_modes: AbstractSet[CUDAGraphMode] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[CUDAGraphMode, BatchDescriptor]:
        """
        Given conditions(e.g.,batch descriptor and if using piecewise only),
        dispatch to a cudagraph runtime mode and the valid batch descriptor.
        A new batch descriptor is returned as we might dispatch a uniform batch
        to a graph that supports a more general batch (uniform to non-uniform).

        Args:
            num_tokens: Number of tokens in the batch.
            uniform_decode: Whether the batch is uniform decode (i.e. uniform and query
                length is uniform_decode_query_len).
            has_lora: Whether LoRA is active.
            num_active_loras: Number of distinct active LoRA adapters.
            valid_modes: Set of cudagraph modes that are allowed. None means
                all modes are allowed.
            invalid_modes: Set of cudagraph modes to exclude. Subtracted from
                valid_modes to compute allowed modes. (e.g., {FULL} for
                features like cascade attention not supported by full
                cudagraphs). None means no modes are excluded.
        """
        allowed_modes = valid_modes or CUDAGraphMode.valid_runtime_modes()

        if invalid_modes:
            allowed_modes -= invalid_modes

        assert len(allowed_modes) >= 1, (
            f"No allowed cudagraph modes: valid_modes={valid_modes}, "
            f"invalid_modes={invalid_modes}"
        )
        max_size = self.compilation_config.max_cudagraph_capture_size

        if (
            not self.keys_initialized
            or self.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE
            or max_size is None
            or num_tokens > max_size
            or allowed_modes <= {CUDAGraphMode.NONE}
        ):
            return CUDAGraphMode.NONE, BatchDescriptor(num_tokens)

        effective_num_active_loras = num_active_loras
        if has_lora and num_active_loras > 0:
            if self.specialize_lora_count:
                # Find the smallest captured `num_active_loras` that is >= the current
                # `num_active_loras`. This is because we only capture graphs for
                # a subset of possible `num_active_loras` values (powers of 2).
                import bisect

                idx = bisect.bisect_left(self.captured_lora_counts, num_active_loras)
                if idx < len(self.captured_lora_counts):
                    effective_num_active_loras = self.captured_lora_counts[idx]
            else:
                # When not specializing, graphs are captured only with max_loras + 1,
                # so we must use max_loras + 1 for dispatch to find a matching graph.
                assert self.vllm_config.lora_config is not None, (
                    "LoRA config must be set when has_lora is True."
                )
                effective_num_active_loras = self.vllm_config.lora_config.max_loras + 1

        normalized_uniform = uniform_decode and self.cudagraph_mode.separate_routine()
        batch_desc = self._create_padded_batch_descriptor(
            num_tokens, normalized_uniform, has_lora, effective_num_active_loras
        )

        if CUDAGraphMode.FULL in allowed_modes:
            # check if key exists for full cudagraph
            batch_desc_to_check = batch_desc
            if batch_desc_to_check in self.cudagraph_keys[CUDAGraphMode.FULL]:
                return CUDAGraphMode.FULL, batch_desc_to_check

        if CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE in allowed_modes:
            # also check if the relaxed key exists for more "general"
            # piecewise cudagraph
            batch_desc_to_check = replace(batch_desc, num_reqs=None, uniform=False)
            if batch_desc_to_check in self.cudagraph_keys[CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE]:
                return CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE, batch_desc_to_check

        assert CUDAGraphMode.NONE in allowed_modes, (
            f"No matching cudagraph found and NONE is not in "
            f"allowed_modes={allowed_modes}"
        )
        return CUDAGraphMode.NONE, BatchDescriptor(num_tokens)

"""Wraps a runnable to add CUDA graph capturing and replaying ability. And
    provide attribute access to the underlying `runnable` via `__getattr__`.

    The workflow of this wrapper in the cudagraph dispatching is as follows:
    1. At initialization, a runtime mode is assigned to the wrapper (FULL or
    PIECEWISE).
    2. At runtime, the wrapper receives a runtime_mode and a
    batch_descriptor(key) from the forward context and blindly trust them
    for cudagraph dispatching.
    3. If runtime_mode is NONE or runtime_mode does not match the mode of the
    wrapper, just call the runnable directly.
    4. Otherwise, i.e., the runtime_mode matches the mode of the wrapper,
    the wrapper will perform cudagraph capture(if key does not exist, create
    a new entry and cache it) or replay (if key exists in the cache).

    Note: CUDAGraphWrapper does not store persistent buffers or copy any
    runtime inputs into that buffers for replay. We assume implementing them
    is done outside of the wrapper. That is because we do not make any

def capture_model(self) -> int:
        if self.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
            logger.warning(
                "Skipping CUDA graph capture. To turn on CUDA graph capture, "
                "ensure `cudagraph_mode` was not manually set to `NONE`"
            )
            return 0

        # Initialize encoder CUDA graph manager if enabled.
        self._maybe_init_encoder_cudagraph_manager()

        compilation_counter.num_gpu_runner_capture_triggers += 1

        start_time = time.perf_counter()

        # Trigger CUDA graph capture for specific shapes.
        # Capture the large shapes first so that the smaller shapes
        # can reuse the memory pool allocated for the large shapes.
        set_cudagraph_capturing_enabled(True)

        # Setup torch profiler for graph capture traces (conditional)
        from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group

        local_rank = get_world_group().local_rank
        enable_profiler = (
            local_rank == 0
        ) and self.vllm_config.profiler_config.capture_torch_profiler
        if enable_profiler:
            trace_dir = (
                self.vllm_config.profiler_config.torch_profiler_dir + "/capture_traces"
            )
            profiler = torch.profiler.profile(
                activities=[
                    torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU,
                    torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA,
                ],
                record_shapes=True,
                profile_memory=True,
                with_stack=True,
                on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler(
                    trace_dir,
                    worker_name=f"graph_capture_rank_{local_rank}",
                    use_gzip=True,
                ),
            )
            logger.info_once(
                "Rank %d: Torch profiler enabled for CUDA graph capture, "
                "traces will be saved to: %s",
                local_rank,
                trace_dir,
            )
        else:
            profiler = nullcontext()
            logger.info_once(
                "Rank %d: Torch profiler disabled for CUDA graph capture", local_rank
            )

        with self._freeze_gc(), graph_capture(device=self.device):
            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
            torch.accelerator.empty_cache()
            start_free_gpu_memory = torch.accelerator.get_memory_info()[0]

            for (
                runtime_mode,
                batch_descs,
            ) in self.cudagraph_dispatcher.get_capture_descs():
                self._capture_cudagraphs(
                    batch_descriptors=batch_descs,
                    cudagraph_runtime_mode=runtime_mode,
                    profiler=profiler,
                )
                torch.accelerator.synchronize()

            # Capture encoder CUDA graphs if enabled
            if self.encoder_cudagraph_manager is not None:
                encoder_graph_pool = current_platform.graph_pool_handle()
                self.encoder_cudagraph_manager.capture(graph_pool=encoder_graph_pool)

            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
            end_free_gpu_memory = torch.accelerator.get_memory_info()[0]

        # Disable cudagraph capturing globally, so any unexpected cudagraph
        # capturing will be detected and raise an error after here.
        # Note: We don't put it into graph_capture context manager because
        # we may do lazy capturing in future that still allows capturing
        # after here.
        set_cudagraph_capturing_enabled(False)

        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
        torch.accelerator.empty_cache()

        # Lock workspace to prevent resizing during execution.
        # Max workspace sizes should have been captured during warmup/profiling.
        lock_workspace()

        end_time = time.perf_counter()
        elapsed_time = end_time - start_time
        cuda_graph_size = start_free_gpu_memory - end_free_gpu_memory
        # This usually takes 5~20 seconds.
        logger.info_once(
            "Graph capturing finished in %.0f secs, took %.2f GiB",
            elapsed_time,
            cuda_graph_size / (1 << 30),
        )
        return cuda_graph_size

def _check_and_update_cudagraph_mode(
        self,
        attention_backends: list[set[type[AttentionBackend]]],
        kv_cache_groups: list[KVCacheGroupSpec],
        is_profiling: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Resolve the cudagraph_mode when there are multiple attention
        groups with potential conflicting CUDA graph support.
        Then initialize the cudagraph_dispatcher based on the resolved
        cudagraph_mode.
        """
        min_cg_support = AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS
        min_cg_attn_backend = None

        for attn_backend_set, kv_cache_group in zip(
            attention_backends, kv_cache_groups
        ):
            for attn_backend in attn_backend_set:
                builder_cls = attn_backend.get_builder_cls()

                cg_support = builder_cls.get_cudagraph_support(
                    self.vllm_config, kv_cache_group.kv_cache_spec
                )
                if cg_support.value < min_cg_support.value:
                    min_cg_support = cg_support
                    min_cg_attn_backend = attn_backend.__name__
        cudagraph_mode = self.compilation_config.resolve_cudagraph_mode_and_sizes(
            min_cg_support,
            min_cg_attn_backend,
            self.uniform_decode_query_len,
            use_v2_model_runner=False,
            tensor_parallel_size=self.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size,
            kv_cache_config=self.kv_cache_config,
            max_num_reqs=self.max_num_reqs,
            is_profiling=is_profiling,
        )
        # Trigger cudagraph dispatching keys initialization after
        # resolved cudagraph mode.
        self.cudagraph_dispatcher.initialize_cudagraph_keys(
            cudagraph_mode, self.uniform_decode_query_len
        )

def compile_or_warm_up_model(self) -> CompilationTimes:
        warmup_sizes: list[int] = []

        if self.vllm_config.compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE:
            # warm up sizes that are not in cudagraph capture sizes,
            # but users still want to compile for better performance,
            # e.g. for the max-num-batched token size in chunked prefill.
            compile_sizes = self.vllm_config.compilation_config.compile_sizes
            warmup_sizes = compile_sizes.copy() if compile_sizes is not None else []  # type: ignore[assignment]
            cg_capture_sizes: list[int] = []

            if self.vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
                cg_sizes = self.vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes
                cg_capture_sizes = [] if cg_sizes is None else cg_sizes
                warmup_sizes = [x for x in warmup_sizes if x not in cg_capture_sizes]

            compile_ranges = self.vllm_config.compilation_config.get_compile_ranges()
            # For each compile_range, if none of the batch sizes
            # in warmup_sizes or cudagraph_capture_sizes are in the range,
            # add the end of the range to ensure compilation/warmup.
            all_sizes = set(cg_capture_sizes)
            all_sizes.update([x for x in warmup_sizes if isinstance(x, int)])
            for compile_range in compile_ranges:
                if not any(x in compile_range for x in all_sizes):
                    warmup_sizes.append(compile_range.end)

        # We skip EPLB here since we don't want to record dummy metrics
        for size in sorted(warmup_sizes, reverse=True):
            logger.info("Compile and warming up model for size %d", size)
            self.model_runner._dummy_run(size, skip_eplb=True, remove_lora=False)
        self.model_runner.maybe_remove_all_loras(self.model_runner.lora_config)

        # Warmup and tune the kernels used during model execution before
        # cuda graph capture.
        kernel_warmup(self)

        cuda_graph_memory_bytes = 0
        if not self.model_config.enforce_eager:
            cuda_graph_memory_bytes = self.model_runner.capture_model()

embed_excerpts.code:
"""Breakable CUDA graph capture/replay.

This is an alternative to :class:`CUDAGraphWrapper` that replaces vLLM's
torch.compile-based FX graph splitting with runtime stream-capture
breaks.

The idea (inspired by sgl-project/sglang#19102): instead of pre-splitting
the model into many pieces at attention boundaries, a
single capture context drives the whole forward and intercepts
attention / kv-cache custom ops at the dispatcher to end the current
stream capture, run the op eagerly, and resume capture.

The captured artifact is a list of zero-arg callables -- the bound
``CUDAGraph.replay`` for graph segments, or the user fn for eager
segments -- replayed in order at inference time.

Eager segments must operate on the same static buffers used during
capture so subsequent graph segments read the same memory addresses.
"""

theory.topic: 形状全等才能回放的本质（CUDA graph 录的到底是什么）
theory.content: CUDA graph 捕获的是『一次前向期间 CPU 向 GPU 提交的全部工作』的参数快照：每个 kernel launch 的 grid/block 配置、参数块里的张量指针、乃至宿主端分支的产出（如 FA3 的 scheduler_metadata 是 CPU 算好再传给 kernel 的——所以 FULL 档连 num_reqs 都必须精确，cudagraph_dispatcher.py:L199-L202）。replay 只是把这串提交原样重发，不会重读张量的 shape/地址元数据。由此推出命中条件的两条：(1) BatchDescriptor 全等——形状变了图执行的就是错误的工作量；(2) 输入地址不变——指针烤死在图里，换了地址图读写的就是错误的数据。前者由 dispatcher 的 padding 尺寸表保证（任意 bs 上取整到捕获形状），后者由 ch18 的固定地址持久缓冲保证——两个条件各有一条设计链供给，DEBUG 模式下的 data_ptr 断言（cuda_graph.py:L346-L355）是第二条的运行期体检。

theory.topic: bs→padded 尺寸表与 padding 浪费算术
theory.content: capture_sizes 是一组分段端点（如 1,2,4,8,16,24,32,...）：段首 bs 保形、段内 bs 上取整到段尾（_compute_bs_to_padded_graph_size，cudagraph_dispatcher.py:L72-L91——zip(capture_sizes+[max+1], [0]+capture_sizes) 的区间填充）。浪费 = padded - bs 行白算：bs=9 pad 到 16 即白算 7 行。decode 一行只有一个 token 的 forward，白算便宜；prefill 一行可达数千 token，贵得多——所以默认捕获尺寸表只到 max_num_seqs 附近的 decode 量级，大 prefill 落 NONE 走 eager/编译图（dispatch L278：num_tokens > max_size 即 NONE）。CUDAGraphStat.num_paddings 把这笔账暴露成可观测指标（L4029-L4036）。

theory.topic: piecewise 的收益模型：编译砍什么、图捕砍什么
theory.content: 两个优化砍的是两种不同的开销：torch.compile（Inductor）砍的是『算子粒度』——把多个小算子融合成大 kernel、消除中间显存往返；CUDA graph 砍的是『提交粒度』——一次 replay 顶替整段 kernel launch 的 CPU→GPU 提交与 Python dispatch。全 eager 的 decode 小 batch：每层几十次 Python dispatch + cudaLaunchKernel，整拍被 CPU 支配（Part V 的靶子）。全图 compile 的死结：attention 有外部副作用（写 KV cache）、动态分支、且动态 batch 触发 guard 反复重编译。piecewise 把『编译单元』降到层间连续段：不可融合处切出去 eager（切点=splitting_ops），可融合段编译后整体捕图——接缝每层约两次（attention + KV update），flash_attn.py:L880-L888 的 NOTE 是接缝成本的官方自白（连 view/slice 都 surprisingly slow）。

theory.topic: 丢 guard 为什么是安全的（一次编译永不回看的前提）
theory.content: torch.compile 的 guard 是『输入还满足编译时的假设吗』的每拍检查；丢掉 guard 意味着赌假设恒成立（wrapper.py:L47-L54）。赌注的抵押品是上游设计链：所有输入张量落在启动期一次分配的固定形状/固定地址缓冲（ch18 CpuGpuBuffer/持久批次）+ 有限个捕获形状经 padding 归一 + mark_dynamic 声明的动态维纪律（@support_torch_compile 从 forward 注解推断，decorators.py:L118-L199）。任何假设被破坏都不会静默——wrapper 的 fullgraph=True 会让 trace 失败直接报错，而不是生成带 guard 的多版本缓存。这是『防重编译』（dynamic shapes 下 guard 风暴）与『可预测性』的合流。

theory.topic: 图池共享与从大到小捕获的显存原理
theory.content: torch.cuda.graph(pool=...) 让多张图共享同一块图私有内存池：后捕的图可以复用先捕图已分配但已死的中间张量显存。CUDA 的池按『捕获顺序 + 张量活性』做分段复用——先捕最大形状，其工作集显存最大；小形状后捕时大部分中间缓冲能落进大图已开的段里，净增显存趋近于输出张量。capture_model 的注释（gpu_model_runner.py:L6829-L6831）与 get_capture_descs 的降序（L326-L350 sorted largest-first for memory efficiency）即此原理的编排面。图池总代价 = capture 前后 mem_get_info 差值（L6911），启动期经 profile_cudagraph_memory 预捕全部形状计入 KV cache 预算（ch14/ch17 的账本接口）。
